Módule 1

Memory Bank

Whether you start with chords or melody, the Memory Bank is where you organize your ideas before taking them to your DAW or instrument.

  • 8 or 16 slots to input or import (via MIDI) chords and melodies
  • 2/4 - 3/4 - 4/4 - 5/4 time signatures
  • Draw a melody on a 4 or 8 step grid with zoom
  • Fully toggleable visibility for chords and/or melodies (together or separately)

Module 2

Scale Module

The Scale Module is the bridge between harmony and melody. Instantly discover compatible scales for any chord and map out the exact notes to craft your melodic lines.

  • 73 scales, from Dorian to Hungarian minor
  • Instant scale matching: Select a chord in the Memory Bank to unlock direct and exotic relative scales.

Module 3

Chord Module

Mark a group as the Reference and rebuild it with 20 arrangement techniques in five families — Energy, Distance, Closure, Variation and Color: applied dominants, modal borrowing, tritone substitution, deceptive endings and more. Every technique starts again from the Reference, so you can try them all.

  • Contextual suggestions: Find next chords or ideal substitutions.
  • Mood-based filtering: Filter chords by emotional character.
  • Scale lock & transposition: Lock or transpose suggestions to your key.

Module 4

Keyboard

Instantly identify chords—exact or partial—right from the keyboard and send any result to a Memory Bank slot.

  • Chord recognition from any set of notes
  • Realistic grand piano sound with smooth voice leading
  • Direct connection: Send your preferred chord straight to the Memory Bank.

Module 5

Library

  • Browse & search: Easily filter by root note, chord type, or search bar.
  • One-click transfer: Send any chord straight into your sequence.

Module 6

Progression Module

Build, transform, and export full chord progressions using real-time atmospheric variations.

  • Load chords from the Memory Bank or type them right into the box.
  • Design a reference group and build up to three variation groups.
  • Select an emotional character to transform your progression's behavior.
  • Direct MIDI export: Drag and drop your progression directly into your DAW or export via button.

Frequently asked questions

Is it a plugin?

No. Gavna Music Composer is a standalone Windows app that works next to your DAW: you drag the result into it as MIDI.

Does it work with my DAW?

With any DAW that accepts MIDI files: drag a slot or a group onto a track, or export a .mid file and import it.

Do I need to know music theory?

No. The suggestions and arrangement techniques do the theory for you, and each one explains what it does in plain words. If you do know theory, you'll find degrees, modes and substitutions ready to use.

Does it use AI to write the music for me?

No. Every suggestion comes from music-theory rules you can see and follow, and every decision is yours. Gavna Music Composer is built to empower your creativity, never to replace it.

Is there a Mac version?

Not yet. Gavna Music Composer runs on Windows 10 and 11.

What happens when the trial ends?

The app asks for a license key to keep opening. Your projects are saved as files on your computer and stay yours whether you buy or not.

Is it a subscription?

No. You pay once and the license never expires. Every version 1 update is included.

Can I get a refund?

Purchases are final, because you can try every feature free for 15 days first. We refund in full if, within 14 days of your purchase, the app doesn't work on your computer and we can't fix it, or if you were charged twice. The details are in our Refund Policy.

Need help?

Write to us and we'll answer within 3 business days. info@gavna.digital
